payload.title: OAuth callback to / on a redirect-root brand returns 500 instead of redirecting to the newsroom
payload.description: On the deployed CMS, GET / returns 307 to /newsroom but GET /?code=abc&state=xyz returns 500 (MarkusSiteRendererError: Site brand "pilobol-us" uses Markus renderer ... Next.js reader routes are not available) thrown from app/page.js via lib/site-renderer.ts. Cause: app/page.tsx skips the rootRoute redirect when hasOAuthRedirectParams is true, then falls through to getSiteRenderer(), which throws for Markus brands. Fix: for rootRoute kind redirect, always redirect to the destination preserving the query string so the Amplify OAuth listener on /newsroom completes sign-in; the reader path must never throw for a Markus brand (notFound instead). Add tests; update docs/site-stacks.md.
